narrative.overview:
beatlabs.ae is a wall of type. A white ground, black ink, and Inter at 900 set as large as the viewport allows, with hairline rules (1px) dividing the page into cells the way a printed broadsheet is divided by column rules. Everything that is not the wall is set small in JetBrains Mono, uppercase and tracked, so the page reads like a record: a display voice and a documentary voice, nothing in between. There are no decorative elements that are not type; the only imagery is the products' real icons, the studios' real marks, one grayscale founder photograph and real product screenshots. Lime is the single mark, reserved for status, the contact cell, the open FAQ, the selection highlight and the press state of a black button.

The site is read, not browsed. A sticky record header (stamp, meta cells, nav cells, a lime contact cell) sits above a marquee that carries the honest status of every module in the portfolio; another marquee closes the page. Between them the layout is a stack of full-bleed rows: a hero wall, a head (heading left, mono label right, on one rule), a grid of cells. Every interactive surface answers in the same way: the block inverts to black. Cells for apps in development are drawn as outlined type and do not react at all; honesty about status is a visual rule, not only copy.

The world was chosen by the owner from real previews (.impeccable/mocks/decision/brutal.png) and then refined by the owner after seeing the wall: rules went from 3px to 1px, utility text moved to mono, and the nav became a record header after estrela.photo. It replaces the terminal home, the dark rail, the lab notebook and every printed-object hand; none of those should be reintroduced.
keyCharacteristics: Two colours plus one mark: white, black, lime. Grey exists only for secondary text, and translucent ink only for soft dividers.
Two faces, two jobs: Inter 400/700/900 for the wall, headings, prose and FAQ questions; JetBrains Mono 400/700 for labels, meta, nav, marquee, buttons and the footer.
Outlined words inside the wall (.out) and outlined step numerals and dev-app names carry emphasis and "not yet" without a second colour.
1px is the rule; 2px is reserved for the focus ring.
Full-bleed rows; the horizontal padding --pad is the only margin.
Hover means invert. Nothing lifts, glows or scales; the only floating chrome (the sticky header, the mobile index sheet) is the exception.
Marquees move; everything else is static. Reduced motion stops them.

rules.name: The Single Mark Rule
rules.body: Lime is the only chroma on the wall. It marks status, contact and the active state; it never tints backgrounds, headings or body copy. If a new element wants colour, the answer is ink or outline, not a second accent.

rules.name: The Icons Carry the Brand Rule
rules.body: Per-product colour appears only through the product's real icon (AppProduct.accent is data for other surfaces; the wall does not read it). The frame stays monochrome so every brand looks like itself.

rules.name: The Invert Rule
rules.body: A hovered or focused interactive block swaps paper and ink (background: ink; color: paper); lime marks inside it stay lime, and mute text becomes mute-on-ink. A black block hovers to lime.

rules.name: The Two Dividers Rule
rules.body: Structural rules (cells, heads, header, marquee, buttons) are solid ink; the dividers inside a list (rows, FAQ items, index links) are translucent ink. Never mix them within one block.

rules.name: The One Rule Between Neighbours Rule
rules.body: Every block draws its own top rule (.marquee, .cells, .head, .rows, .faq, .contact, .block--rule), and that rule is dropped when the block above already closes with a line. The adjacent-sibling group under "Rules & marquee" in app/globals.css does the dropping (.rec + .marquee, .cells + .marquee, .cells + .head, .cells + .cells, .cells + .rows, .cells + .faq, .cells + .contact, .cells + .block--rule, .rows + .head, .rows + .cells, .rows + .contact, .rows + .marquee, .faq + .head, .faq + .cells, .faq + .contact, .faq + .marquee → border-top: 0). Blocks that close with a solid line: the record header, a cell grid (each cell's bottom border), spec rows (the last row's divider is still translucent, so .rows counts as closed only for the layout, not the ink), and the FAQ, whose details:last-child closes in solid ink. A new block type joins the system by owning its top rule and adding its pairings to that group; never fake a rule with an inline borderTop.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Inter speaks (wall, headings, names, prose, questions); Mono annotates (labels, meta, nav, ticker, buttons, footer, header cells). A new element is one or the other; never set a heading in Mono or a label in Inter.

rules.name: The Outline Means Not Yet Rule
rules.body: Outlined type (paper fill, hairline ink stroke) is the emphasis device inside the wall (0.018em) and the "not yet" device everywhere else: step numerals still to come (1.5px), apps in development (1px). Do not outline a live product's name.

rules.name: The Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Every Inter 900 role is uppercase except big (the founder's greeting) and num/mail, whose content is numeric or an address; every Mono role is uppercase except meta and the index numerals. Prose and FAQ questions stay sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Wall Rule
rules.body: Rows, cells, buttons and heads never carry a shadow, gradient or blur; if a surface needs to read as raised or active, it inverts. Blur and shadow belong only to chrome that physically floats over the page (the sticky header, the index sheet).

dos: Do build every new section as rule → head → cells or rows, inside --pad, with 1px ink borders. The rhythm is the identity.
Do set the page statement in .wall with exactly one .out phrase, uppercase, and keep it under four lines (use the long variant clamp(2.8rem, 10.5vw, 9.4rem) when the copy runs long).
Do open a cell with its name only; no eyebrow label above a display line. Labels caption values (stats, prices, spec keys) and sit on the head's rule.
Do set every annotation (label, meta, nav, ticker, button, footer, header cell) in JetBrains Mono, uppercase and tracked, at 0.66 to 0.74rem; keep Inter for everything that speaks.
Do print every status on a lime .mark in its cell and in the marquee, from data/portfolio.ts; dev items are outlined, mute and inert.
Do make every interactive block invert on hover and focus-visible; keep the 2px ink focus outline.
Do use the products' real icons (44px, squircle-masked) and real screenshots only; never fabricate product UI.
Do keep the founder photo and any future photography grayscale and edge to edge in a .cell--photo.
Do use solid ink rules between structural blocks and translucent dividers inside lists (rows, FAQ, index sheet).
Do give every new block its own top rule and register its neighbour pairings in the adjacent-sibling group so two blocks never draw two lines between them.
donts: Don't add a second accent, tint backgrounds, or read AppProduct.accent into the wall; brand colour arrives through icons only.
